propositions: A runaway read_file loop triggers the runaway guard, which truncates the evidence search and aborts; the aborted/truncated criterion is never banked (entry is None)
The _restamp_marker function pops the insufficiency marker when entry is None instead of stamping it, minting a bare met=false indistinguishable from a genuine refutation

reconcile_verdict sets top-level evidence_sufficient=False on insufficiency-only FAIL but does not set verdict_obtainable=False, so the close gate routes to hard-coded exit 1 instead of retryable exit 11

The fix introduces completion_fail_returncode helper to return exit 11 when evidence_sufficient is False OR verdict_obtainable is False, else exit 1, shared by close_precheck and verify-completion verb
An insufficiency-only FAIL (truncated, un-banked criteria) must dispose as retryable exit 11 so the ticket does not close, while genuine refutations (present entry with no marker) must stay exit 1
